meta.name: gemini-interactions-api
meta.description: Guides the usage of Gemini Interactions API on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Use when the user wants to use the stateful, server-managed Interactions API for multi-turn conversations, background execution, streaming, structured output, and function calling on the Agent Platform.

copy.tagline: 调用 Gemini 交互 API 构建多轮对话与函数调用
copy.tagline_en: Use Gemini Interactions API for multi-turn conversations and function calling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use the Interactions API on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for conversational apps.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 上的 Interactions API，包括多轮对话、后台执行、流式输出、结构化输出和函数调用。
howto.when: 当你想在 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 上使用有状态、服务端管理的 Interactions API 进行多轮对话、后台任务、流式输出、结构化输出或函数调用时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Gemini Interactions API 创建一个单轮对话。
say.note: Claude 会给出 Python 或 JS 代码示例。

say.text: 如何用 Interactions API 实现多轮对话？
用 Interactions API 做流式输出，写一首诗。
say.note: Claude 会给出流式请求的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in using the Gemini Interactions API on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, including multi-turn conversations, background execution, streaming, structured output, and function calling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to use the stateful, server-managed Interactions API on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for multi-turn conversations, background tasks, streaming, structured output, or function calling.

say_en.text: Help me create a single-turn interaction using the Gemini Interactions API.
say_en.note: Claude will provide Python or JS code examples.

say_en.text: How do I implement multi-turn conversations with the Interactions API?
say_en.note: Claude will show code using previous_interaction_id.

say_en.text: Use the Interactions API for streaming output to write a poem.
say_en.note: Claude will provide streaming request code.
